description:
A mission planner has provided finalized specifications for the 'Draft Survey Mission'. Your task is to update this existing flight plan in the Aerobridge system.

Read the file located at '~/Documents/mission_specs.txt' to find the required Start Time, End Time, and Boundary Coordinates.

Then, navigate to the Aerobridge Admin panel (http://localhost:8000/admin/), find the Flight Plan named 'Draft Survey Mission', and update it:
1. Set the Start Time and End Time to match the specifications exactly.
2. Convert the provided coordinate list into a valid GeoJSON Polygon format and paste it into the Geometry field. Ensure the polygon ring is closed (the last coordinate must match the first).

Note: The text file provides coordinates as 'Latitude, Longitude', but GeoJSON requires '[Longitude, Latitude]'.

Save the changes when done.
